study.decision_rule: Both screening and independent-seed confirmation must falsify an operational claim; errors and inconclusive panels count as zero falsifications.
study.development_seeds: 84000..84079 were development only; campaign seed derivation uses distinct frozen bases
study.independent_reference: The repeated unadjusted binomial test has an analytically computable stable-session false-alert probability; simulation and independent numeric e-value checks must agree with their assumptions.
limitations: The FIFO arm is a matched policy ablation on a NEW CPU backend, not an end-to-end baseline of prior Bethesda R.A.I.N.
Declared rival predictions intentionally encode the repeated-testing concern. This tests use of supplied models, not autonomous discovery of those probabilities.
One frozen benchmark instance and one independent-seed replicate panel; no population-level proof of general scheduler superiority.
Full validation also measures DRR short-signal null failures. Neither a 75% correctness criterion nor a non-falsified interval proves nominal 5% error control.
study.primary: Number of predeclared incorrect scientific claims falsified in BOTH panels per 192 work units; information must exceed FIFO.
